paragraphs: The X5 M60i is the V8 performance flagship of the G05 X5 generation, producing 523hp from its 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8. It represents BMW's most modern V8 in the X5 range, positioned above the six-cylinder xDrive40i and alongside the plug-in hybrid xDrive50e. The M60i's exact engine code is not yet independently confirmed — it is understood to be a successor to the N63 family, but should not be assumed identical to the F15 xDrive50i's N63 pattern without confirmation. We confirm your exact engine specification by registration before quoting any work.
about.boldParagraph: The X5 M60i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
